title: The finite discrete coefficient encoding on one stratum
statement: For the data of [def-weil-pbc-common-finite-discrete-encoding] with B finite discrete, let S be a finite stratification of T and a a stratum. If the internal restriction of M to S_a is locally finitely presented, the ordinary restriction of E_T.inverse M to S_a is finite locally constant in the sense of [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf].

source.place: Proposition 5.3.2 and Lemmas 5.4.1 and 5.4.3; Stacks Project Tag 09AK

proof.text: Choose the cover and finite constant cokernel presentations of the ordinary restriction.
Each cokernel is finite locally constant on its cover member.

Choose the finite constant trivialization covers and bind them with the presentation cover. The inverse-image composition isomorphism identifies the composite restrictions and yields one covering family of the stratum.
